rows.english: Check the farm details before choosing
rows.zu: Hlola imininingwane yepulazi ngaphambi kokukhetha
rows.st: Hlahloba dintlha tsa polasi pele o kgetha
rows.ts: Kambela vuxokoxoko bya purasi u nga si hlawula
rows.ve: Sedzulusani mafhungo a bulasi musi ni sa athu u nanga

rows.english: These are options to discuss, not a final breed recommendation. Confirm healthy stock, supplier availability, ventilation, chick warmth and a health plan locally. Record actual production months separately; this guide promises no output or dates.
rows.zu: Lezi yizinketho zokuxoxa ngazo, hhayi isincomo sokugcina sohlobo. Qinisekisa izinyoni eziphilile, ukutholakala kumhlinzeki, ukungena komoya, ukufudumala kwamachwane nohlelo lwezempilo endaweni. Rekhoda izinyanga zokukhiqiza zangempela ngokwehlukana; lo mhlahlandlela awuthembisi umkhiqizo noma izinsuku.
rows.st: Tsena ke dikgetho tsa ho buisana, eseng keletso ya ho qetela ya mofuta. Netefatsa dinonyana tse phetseng hantle, ho fumaneha ho mofani, moya o kenang, mofuthu wa ditsuonyana le moralo wa bophelo sebakeng seo. Rekota dikgwedi tsa tlhahiso ya nnete ka thoko; tataiso ena ha e tshepise tlhahiso kapa matsatsi.
rows.ts: Leswi i swihlawuriwa swo burisana, ku nga ri xitsundzuxo xo hetelela xa muxaka. Tiyisisa tihuku leti hanyeke kahle, ku kumeka eka muphakeri, moya lowu nghenaka, ku kufumela ka swikukwana ni kungu ra rihanyo endhawini. Rhekhoda tin’hweti ta vuhumelerisi bya xiviri hi ku hambana; xiletelo lexi a xi tshembisi vuhumelerisi kumbe masiku.
rows.ve: Izwi ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa u itela u haseledza, hu si nyeletshedzo ya u fhedzisela ya lushaka. Khwaṱhisedzani khuhu dzi re na mutakalo, u wanala kha muṋetshedzi, mufhe, mufhiso wa zwikukwana na pulane ya mutakalo henefho. Rekhodani miṅwedzi ya mveledzo ya vhukuma nga thungo; nyeletshedzo iyi a i fulufhedzisi mveledzo kana maḓuvha.

rows.english: What are the chickens for: eggs, meat or both?
rows.zu: Izinkukhu ezani: amaqanda, inyama noma kokubili?
rows.st: Dikgoho ke tsa eng: mahe, nama kapa bobedi?
rows.ts: Tihuku i ta yini: matandza, nyama kumbe haswimbirhi?
rows.ve: Khuhu ndi dza mini: makumba, ṋama kana zwoṱhe?

rows.english: Is clean drinking water always available?
rows.zu: Ingabe amanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza ahlala etholakala?
rows.st: Na metsi a hlwekileng a ho nwa a dula a le teng?
rows.ts: Xana mati yo nwa lama baseke ma kumeka nkarhi hinkwawu?
rows.ve: Naa maḓi o kunaho a u nwa a dzula a tshi wanala?

rows.english: What feed is available?
rows.zu: Yikuphi ukudla kwezilwane okutholakalayo?
rows.st: Ke dijo dife tsa diphoofolo tse teng?
rows.ts: Hi swihi swakudya swa swifuwo leswi kumekaka?
rows.ve: Ndi zwiḽiwa zwifhio zwa zwifuwo zwi re hone?

rows.english: Are the birds protected at night?
rows.zu: Ingabe izinyoni zivikelekile ebusuku?
rows.st: Na dinonyana di sireleditswe bosiu?
rows.ts: Xana tihuku ti sirhelelekile nivusiku?
rows.ve: Naa khuhu dzo tsireledzea vhusiku?

rows.english: Every breed needs clean drinking water, suitable feed and protected housing.
rows.zu: Lonke uhlobo ludinga amanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza, ukudla okufanele nendawo yokuhlala evikelekile.
rows.st: Mofuta o mong le o mong o hloka metsi a hlwekileng a ho nwa, dijo tse loketseng le matlo a sireleditsweng.
rows.ts: Muxaka wun’wana ni wun’wana wu lava mati yo nwa lama baseke, swakudya leswi faneleke ni tindlu leti sirhelelekeke.
rows.ve: Lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe lu ṱoḓa maḓi o kunaho a u nwa, zwiḽiwa zwo teaho na nnḓu dzo tsireledzeaho.

rows.english: Foraging alone may not supply enough nutrients for eggs.
rows.zu: Ukuzifunela ukudla kukodwa kungase kunganikezi izakhamzimba ezanele zamaqanda.
rows.st: Ho ipatlela dijo feela ho ka nna ha se fane ka dimatlafatsi tse lekaneng bakeng sa mahe.
rows.ts: Ku tihlotela swakudya ntsena swi nga ha nga nyiki swakudya swo aka miri leswi eneleke swa matandza.
rows.ve: U ḓiṱoḓela zwiḽiwa fhedzi zwi nga kha ḓi sa ṋea pfushi yo eḓanaho ya makumba.

rows.english: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
rows.zu: Amanzi okulima alinganiselwe. Hlola amanzi okuphuza ngokwehlukana; amanzi engadi awaqinisekisi amanzi aphephile ezinkukhu.
rows.st: Metsi a temo a haella. Hlahloba metsi a ho nwa ka thoko; metsi a serapeng ha a netefatse phepelo e bolokehileng bakeng sa dikgoho.
rows.ts: Mati yo byala ma kayivela. Kambela mati yo nwa hi ku hambana; mati ya ntanga a ma tiyisisi mphakelo lowu hlayisekeke wa tihuku.
rows.ve: Maḓi a u lima a kha ḓi vha maṱuku. Sedzulusani maḓi a u nwa nga thungo; maḓi a ngade a ha khwaṱhisedzi nḓisedzo yo tsireledzeaho ya khuhu.

rows.english: You reported wet ground. Check that chicken housing drains and bedding stays dry.
rows.zu: Ubike umhlabathi omanzi. Hlola ukuthi amanzi ayaphuma ezindlini zezinkukhu nezinto zokulala zihlala zomile.
rows.st: O tlalehile mobu o metsi. Hlahloba hore metsi a tswa matlong a dikgoho le hore bolao bo dula bo omme.
rows.ts: U vike misava leyi tsakamaka. Kambela leswaku mati ma huma etindlwini ta tihuku ni leswaku swo andlalela swi tshamisa swi omile.
rows.ve: No vhiga mavu a re na maḓi. Sedzulusani uri maḓi a bve nnḓuni dza khuhu na uri zwa u lala zwi dzule zwo oma.

rows.english: You reported frost. Check winter shelter and chick warmth with a local adviser.
rows.zu: Ubike isithwathwa. Hlola indawo yokukhosela ebusika nokufudumala kwamachwane nomeluleki wendawo.
rows.st: O tlalehile serame. Hlahloba tshireletso ya mariha le mofuthu wa ditsuonyana le moeletsi wa sebaka seo.
rows.ts: U vike gwitsi. Kambela vutumbelo bya xixika ni ku kufumela ka swikukwana ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu.
rows.ve: No vhiga murotholo. Sedzulusani vhudzumbamo ha vhuria na mufhiso wa zwikukwana na muṋeletshedzi wa henefho.

rows.english: In hot weather, provide shade, airflow and reliable water. This is general care advice; heat at this site has not been confirmed.
rows.zu: Uma kushisa, nikeza umthunzi, ukungena komoya namanzi athembekile. Lezi yizeluleko zokunakekela ezijwayelekile; ukushisa kule ndawo akuqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: Ha ho tjhesa, fana ka moriti, moya o phallang le metsi a tshepahalang. Ena ke keletso ya tlhokomelo ka kakaretso; motjheso sebakeng sena ha o eso netefatswe.
rows.ts: Loko ku hisa, nyika ndzhuti, moya lowu fambaka ni mati lama tiyisekeke. Lexi i xitsundzuxo xa nhlayiso hi ku angarhela; ku hisa endhawini leyi a ku si tiyisisiwa.
rows.ve: Musi hu tshi fhisa, ṋeani murunzi, mufhe u tshimbilaho na maḓi a fulufhedzeaho. Iyi ndi nyeletshedzo ya ṱhogomelo nga u angaredza; u fhisa ha fhethu afha a hu athu u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Local chicken adaptation varies within provinces. Location alone does not identify the best breed for this farm.
rows.zu: Ukufaneleka kwezinkukhu zendawo kuyahlukahluka ngaphakathi kwezifundazwe. Indawo iyodwa ayibonisi uhlobo olungcono kakhulu lwaleli pulazi.
rows.st: Ho ikamahanya ha dikgoho tsa lehae ho fapana ka hare ho diprofinse. Sebaka feela ha se bontshe mofuta o motle ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa polasi ena.
rows.ts: Ku tolovela ka tihuku ta le kaya ku hambana endzeni ka swifundzhankulu. Ndhawu ntsena a yi kombi muxaka lowu faneleke ngopfu purasi leri.
rows.ve: U ḓowelana ha khuhu dza hayani na fhethu zwi a fhambana ngomu ha mavunḓu. Fhethu fhedzi a hu sumbedzi lushaka lwa khwine lwa bulasi iḽi.

rows.english: An egg-and-meat option. It outperformed the other indigenous breeds for eggs in a managed ARC trial; those results do not predict this farm.
rows.zu: Inketho yamaqanda nenyama. Yaveza amaqanda amaningi kunezinye izinhlobo zomdabu ocwaningweni lwe-ARC olwalulawulwa; leyo miphumela ayibikezeli leli pulazi.
rows.st: Kgetho ya mahe le nama. E hlahisitse mahe a mangata ho feta mefuta e meng ya lehae tekong e laolwang ya ARC; diphetho tseo ha di bolele se tla etsahala polasing ena.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa matandza ni nyama. Yi humesile matandza yo tala ku hundza tinxaka tin’wana ta ndzhavuko eka ndzingo lowu lawuriweke wa ARC; mimbuyelo yoleyo a yi vhumbi purasi leri.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa makumba na ṋama. Yo bveledza makumba manzhi u fhira dziṅwe tshaka dza hayani kha ndingo yo langwaho ya ARC; mvelelo idzo a dzi vhumbi bulasi iḽi.

rows.english: An ARC-conserved indigenous option for eggs and meat; check local stock and care needs.
rows.zu: Inketho yomdabu egcinwe yi-ARC yamaqanda nenyama; hlola izinyoni ezitholakala endaweni nezidingo zokunakekela.
rows.st: Kgetho ya lehae e bolokilweng ke ARC bakeng sa mahe le nama; hlahloba dinonyana tsa sebaka seo le ditlhoko tsa tlhokomelo.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa ndzhavuko lexi hlayisiweke hi ARC xa matandza ni nyama; kambela tihuku ta le ndhawini ni swilaveko swa nhlayiso.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa hayani zwo vhulungwaho nga ARC zwa makumba na ṋama; sedzulusani khuhu dza henefho na ṱhoḓea dza ṱhogomelo.

rows.english: An indigenous option described across diverse South African climates; confirm suitability with local advice.
rows.zu: Inketho yomdabu echazwe ezimweni zezulu ezahlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika; qinisekisa ukufaneleka ngezeluleko zendawo.
rows.st: Kgetho ya lehae e hlalositsweng maemong a tlelaemete a fapaneng a Afrika Borwa; netefatsa ho tshwaneleha ka keletso ya sebaka seo.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa ndzhavuko lexi hlamuseriweke eka maxelo yo hambana ya Afrika-Dzonga; tiyisisa ku faneleka hi switsundzuxo swa ndhawu.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa hayani zwo ṱaluswaho kha kilima dzo fhambanaho dza Afurika Tshipembe; khwaṱhisedzani u tea hazwo nga nyeletshedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: Consider only after checking reliable feed, drinking water, housing, health care and managed lighting. Breed and supplier still need local confirmation.
rows.zu: Cabanga ngale nketho kuphela emva kokuhlola ukudla okuthembekile, amanzi okuphuza, izindlu, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo nokukhanyisa okulawulwayo. Uhlobo nomhlinzeki kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni.
rows.st: Nahana ka yona feela ka mora ho hlahloba dijo tse tshepahalang, metsi a ho nwa, matlo, tlhokomelo ya bophelo le mabone a laolwang. Mofuta le mofani di sa hloka netefatso sebakeng seo.
rows.ts: Yi tekeleni enhlokweni ntsena endzhaku ko kambela swakudya leswi tiyisekeke, mati yo nwa, tindlu, nhlayiso wa rihanyo ni mavoni lama lawuriwaka. Muxaka ni muphakeri swa ha lava ku tiyisisiwa endhawini.
rows.ve: Dzi dzhieleni nṱha fhedzi nga murahu ha u sedzulusa zwiḽiwa zwi fulufhedzeaho, maḓi a u nwa, nnḓu, ṱhogomelo ya mutakalo na mavhone a langwaho. Lushaka na muṋetshedzi zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: Needs dependable balanced feed, water, suitable housing and management. Confirm chick supply and a meat outlet before choosing.
rows.zu: Idinga ukudla okunomsoco olinganiselwe okuthembekile, amanzi, izindlu ezifanele nokuphathwa. Qinisekisa ukutholakala kwamachwane nendawo yokudayisa inyama ngaphambi kokukhetha.
rows.st: E hloka dijo tse leka-lekaneng tse tshepahalang, metsi, matlo a loketseng le tsamaiso. Netefatsa phepelo ya ditsuonyana le sebaka sa ho rekisa nama pele o kgetha.
rows.ts: Yi lava swakudya leswi ringaniseriweke leswi tiyisekeke, mati, tindlu leti faneleke ni vulawuri. Tiyisisa mphakelo wa swikukwana ni ndhawu yo xavisa nyama u nga si hlawula.
rows.ve: Zwi ṱoḓa zwiḽiwa zwa pfushi yo linganelaho zwi fulufhedzeaho, maḓi, nnḓu dzo teaho na ndangulo. Khwaṱhisedzani nḓisedzo ya zwikukwana na fhethu ha u rengisa ṋama musi ni sa athu u nanga.

rows.st: Ntlafatsa tshireletso ya bosiu le matlo a sireletsang kgahlanong le maemo a lehodimo.
rows.ts: Antswisa nsirhelelo wa nivusiku ni tindlu leti sirhelelaka eka maxelo.
rows.ve: Khwinifhadzani tsireledzo ya vhusiku na nnḓu dzi tsireledzaho kha mutsho.

rows.english: Check feed suitability; scavenging and scraps may not meet laying hens’ needs.
rows.zu: Hlola ukufaneleka kokudla; ukuzifunela ukudla nezinsalela kungase kungahlangabezani nezidingo zezikhukhukazi ezizalelayo.
rows.st: Hlahloba ho tshwaneleha ha dijo; ho ipatlela dijo le masalla ho ka nna ha se kgotsofatse ditlhoko tsa dikgoho tse behelang.
rows.ts: Kambela ku faneleka ka swakudya; ku tihlotela swakudya ni masalela swi nga ha nga enerisi swilaveko swa tihuku leti tshikelaka.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani u tea ha zwiḽiwa; u ḓiṱoḓela zwiḽiwa na masalela zwi nga kha ḓi sa swikelela ṱhoḓea dza khuhu dzi khou kudzelaho.

rows.english: Secure reliable clean drinking water before buying more birds.
rows.zu: Qinisekisa amanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile nathembekile ngaphambi kokuthenga izinyoni ezengeziwe.
rows.st: Fumana metsi a hlwekileng a ho nwa a tshepahalang pele o reka dinonyana tse ding.
rows.ts: Tiyisisa mati yo nwa lama baseke lama tiyisekeke u nga si xava tihuku tin’wana.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani maḓi o kunaho a u nwa a fulufhedzeaho musi ni sa athu u renga khuhu dziṅwe.

rows.st: Kgwebo ya dikgoho eo o e kgethileng le morero o rekotilweng di a fapana; di hlahlobe hammoho.
rows.ts: Bindzu ra tihuku leri u ri hlawuleke ni xikongomelo lexi rhekhodiweke swa hambana; swi kambisise swin’we.
rows.ve: Bindu ḽa khuhu ḽe na nanga na ndivho yo rekhodiwaho zwi a fhambana; zwi sedzuluseni zwoṱhe.

rows.zu: Sebenzisa lokho okubonile epulazini nohlu olufushane locwaningo. Qinisekisa izinketho endaweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Sebedisa seo o se boneng polasing le manane a makgutshwane a dipatlisiso. Netefatsa dikgetho sebakeng seo pele o reka.
rows.ts: Tirhisa leswi u swi voneke epurasini ni minxaxamelo yo koma ya ndzavisiso. Tiyisisa swihlawuriwa endhawini u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Shumisani zwe na zwi vhona bulasini na mitevhe mipfufhi ya ṱhoḓisiso. Khwaṱhisedzani zwine na nanga henefho musi ni sa athu u renga.

rows.zu: Umlimi ubika amanzi okutshalela athembekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi amanzi anele umjikelezo ngamunye wezitshalo ohleliwe.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha metsi a tshepahalang a ho lema. Netefatsa hore phepelo e ka lekana potoloho ka nngwe e rerilweng ya dijalo.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika mati yo byala lama kumekaka nkarhi ni nkarhi. Tiyisisa leswaku mphakelo wu nga enerisa ndzhendzeleko wun’wana ni wun’wana wa swibyariwa lowu kunguhatiweke.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga maḓi a u lima a fulufhedzeaho. Khwaṱhisedzani uri mphakelo u nga kona mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa zwiliṅwa wo pulanwaho.

rows.english: Farmer reports limited growing water. Confirm which beds can be watered before buying planting material.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika amanzi okutshalela alinganiselwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi yimiphi imibhede enganiselwa ngaphambi kokuthenga okokutshala.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha metsi a fokolang a ho lema. Netefatsa hore ke dibethe dife tse ka nosetswang pele o reka dintho tsa ho jala.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika mati matsongo yo byala. Tiyisisa leswaku i mibedo yihi leyi nga cheletiwaka u nga si xava swilo swo byala.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga maḓi a u lima a songo eḓanaho. Khwaṱhisedzani uri ndi mimbete ifhio ine ya nga sheledzwa ni sa athu u renga zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha.

rows.english: Farmer reports rain-only growing. Use this site's rain-fed crop checks; water for animals is a separate need.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika ukuthi ukutshala kuncike emvuleni kuphela. Sebenzisa ukuhlolwa kwezitshalo ezincike emvuleni kwale ndawo; amanzi ezilwane ayisidingo esihlukile.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha temo e itshetlehileng ka pula feela. Sebedisa ditlhahlobo tsa dijalo tsa sebaka sena tse nosetswang ke pula; metsi a diphoofolo ke tlhoko e arohaneng.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika ku byala hi mpfula ntsena. Tirhisa minkambelo ya swibyariwa swa ndhawu leyi leswi titshegeke hi mpfula; mati ya swifuwo i xilaveko xin’wana.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga u lima nga mvula fhedzi. Shumisani u ṱola zwiliṅwa zwa fhethu hafha zwi no ḓitika nga mvula; maḓi a zwifuwo ndi ṱhoḓea yo fhambanaho.

rows.english: Not recorded. Complete the site survey and confirm water before choosing an intensive plan.
rows.zu: Akurekhodiwe. Qedela inhlolovo yendawo bese uqinisekisa amanzi ngaphambi kokukhetha uhlelo oludinga izinsiza eziningi.
rows.st: Ha ho a rekotwa. Qetella phuputso ya sebaka mme o netefatse metsi pele o kgetha moralo o hlokang disebediswa tse ngata.
rows.ts: A swi rhekhodiwanga. Hetisa vulavisisi bya ndhawu u tiyisisa mati u nga si hlawula kungu leri lavaka switirhisiwa swo tala.
rows.ve: A zwo ngo rekhodwa. Fhedzisani ṱhoḓisiso ya fhethu ni khwaṱhisedze maḓi ni sa athu u nanga pulane ine ya ṱoḓa zwishumiswa zwinzhi.

rows.zu: Umlimi ubika ukuthi akabonanga isithwathwa. Lokhu akufakazeli ukuthi ubusika obuzayo ngeke bube nesithwathwa.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha hore ha a eso bone serame. Sena ha se tiise hore mariha a tlang a ke ke a ba le serame.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika leswaku a nga si vona rharhama. Ku vona loku a ku tiyisisi leswaku vuxika bya nkarhi lowu taka byi ta pfumala rharhama.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga uri ha athu u vhona murotholo. Izwi a zwi khwaṱhisedzi uri vhuria vhu ḓaho a vhu nga vhi na murotholo.

rows.english: Local frost observations are not recorded. Satellite monthly averages cannot establish first and last frost dates.
rows.zu: Okubonwe ngesithwathwa endaweni akurekhodiwe. Izilinganiso zanyanga zonke zesathelayithi azikwazi ukuthola izinsuku zokuqala nezokugcina zesithwathwa.
rows.st: Se bonweng ka serame sebakeng ha se a rekotwa. Dikarolelano tsa kgwedi tsa sathelaete di ke ke tsa tiisa matsatsi a pele le a ho qetela a serame.
rows.ts: Leswi voniweke hi rharhama endhawini a swi rhekhodiwanga. Miringaniso ya n’hweti ya sathelayiti a yi koti ku tiyisisa masiku yo sungula ni yo hetelela ya rharhama.
rows.ve: Zwe zwa vhonwa nga murotholo wa henefho a zwo ngo rekhodwa. Zwikati zwa ṅwedzi zwa sathelaithi a zwi koni u khwaṱhisedza maḓuvha a murotholo wa u thoma na wa u fhedza.

rows.st: Maemo a lehodimo a sebaka sena ha a eso hlake, kahoo ha ho bolelwe lenane le lekgutshwane la sebaka. Bula karete ya sejalo ho bona mehlodi le ho rekota kgetho ya hao.
rows.ts: Maxelo ya ndhawu leyi a ma si tiveka, kutani a ku vuriwi leswaku ku ni nxaxamelo wo koma wa ndhawu. Pfula khadi ra xibyariwa u vona swihlovo ni ku rhekhoda xihlawuriwa xa wena.
rows.ve: Kilima ya fhethu hafha a i athu u ṱalutshedzea, ngauralo a hu buliwi mutevhe mupfufhi wa henefho. Vulani garaṱa ya tshiliṅwa u vhona zwiko na u rekhoda zwe na nanga.

rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kokusetshenziswa njengokudla: kugcinwa ohlwini lwemephu; umkhiqizo oqinisekisiwe awukona ukudla kwasekhaya. Akucatshangwa ukutholakala noma ukukhiqizwa kokudla okuvamile.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya tshebediso e le dijo: se bolokwa lethathamong la mmapa; sehlahiswa se netefaditsweng ha se dijo tsa lelapa. Ha ho nahannwe boteng kapa tlhahiso e tlwaelehileng ya dijo.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wa ku tirhisiwa ku ri swakudya: swi hlayisiwa eka nxaxamelo wa mepe; xikumiwa lexi tiyisisiweke a hi swakudya swa le kaya. A ku ehleketiwi ku kumeka kumbe vuhumelerisi bya swakudya swa ntolovelo.
rows.ve: U sedzulusa tshumiso ya zwiḽiwa: zwi vhulungwa kha mutevhe wa mapa; tshibveledzwa tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho a si zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa. A hu humbulelwi u wanala kana vhubveledzi ha zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho.

rows.english: Food-use review: confirm identity, edible part and appropriate preparation with a qualified local adviser before including this plant as household food. Held out of ordinary food totals and picking jobs.
rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kokusetshenziswa njengokudla: qinisekisa ubunikazi, ingxenye edliwayo nokulungiswa okufanele nomeluleki wendawo oqeqeshiwe ngaphambi kokufaka lesi sitshalo ekudleni kwasekhaya. Asibalwa ezambeni zokudla okuvamile nasemisebenzini yokuvuna.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya tshebediso e le dijo: netefatsa hore ke semela sefe, karolo e jewang le tokiso e nepahetseng le moeletsi wa sebaka ya nang le tsebo pele o se kenya dijong tsa lelapa. Se tlohetswe dikakaretsong tsa dijo tse tlwaelehileng le mesebetsing ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wa ku tirhisiwa ku ri swakudya: tiyisisa leswaku i ximilana xihi, xiphemu lexi dyiwaka ni malunghiselelo lama faneleke ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu loyi a nga ni vutivi u nga si xi katsa eka swakudya swa le kaya. A xi katsiwanga eka tinhlayo ta swakudya swa ntolovelo ni mintirho yo tshovela.
rows.ve: U sedzulusa tshumiso ya zwiḽiwa: khwaṱhisedzani vhuvha, tshipiḓa tshi ḽiwaho na u lugisela ho teaho na mueletshedzi wa henefho a re na ndalukanyo ni sa athu u katela tshimela itshi kha zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa. A tshi katelwi kha zwivhalo zwa zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho na mishumo ya u kaṋa.

rows.english: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
rows.zu: Ukuhlola indawo ebandayo: lezi zinkomba zezindawo ezifudumele azifakazeli ukufaneleka lapha. Qinisekisa indawo evikelekile esithwathweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya sebaka se batang: ditshupiso tsena tsa dibaka tse futhumetseng ha di tiise hore ho loketse mona. Netefatsa sebaka se sireleditsweng serameng pele o reka.
rows.ts: Nkambelo wa ndhawu yo titimela: swikombo leswi swa tindhawu leti kufumelaka a swi tiyisisi leswaku swi fanele laha. Tiyisisa ndhawu leyi sirhelelekeke eka rharhama u nga si xava.
rows.ve: U ṱola fhethu hu rotholelaho: ndaedzi idzi dza vhupo vhu dudelaho a dzi khwaṱhisedzi uri zwi tea hafha. Khwaṱhisedzani fhethu ho tsireledzwaho kha murotholo ni sa athu u renga.

rows.english: Assumed planting variety: Grand Nain for a warm site; use the wind/cold alternatives in the buying advice if those conditions apply. Local picking months remain unconfirmed.
rows.zu: Uhlobo olucatshangwayo lokutshala: Grand Nain endaweni efudumele; sebenzisa ezinye izinketho zomoya/amakhaza ezelulekweni zokuthenga uma lezo zimo zikhona. Izinyanga zokuvuna zendawo azikaqinisekiswa.
rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Grand Nain bakeng sa sebaka se futhumetseng; sebedisa mefuta e meng bakeng sa moya/serame e keletsong ya ho reka haeba maemo ao a le teng. Dikgwedi tsa kotulo tsa sebaka ha di eso netefatswe.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Grand Nain eka ndhawu yo kufumela; tirhisa swihlawuriwa swin’wana swa moya/ku titimela leswi nga eka switsundzuxo swo xava loko ku ri ni swiyimo swoleswo. Tin’hweti to tshovela ta ndhawu a ti si tiyisisiwa.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Grand Nain kha fhethu hu dudelaho; shumisani dziṅwe nḓila dza muya/murotho dzi re kha nyeletshedzo ya u renga arali nyimele idzo dzi hone. Miṅwedzi ya henefho ya u kaṋa a i athu u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Assumed planting variety: Sunrise Solo, subject to a frost-free, drained growing position. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
rows.zu: Uhlobo olucatshangwayo lokutshala: Sunrise Solo, uma indawo yokukhula ingenayo isithwathwa futhi amanzi ephuma. Qinisekisa izinyanga zalo zokuvuna endaweni; ikhalenda lisebenzisa inkomba yesifunda ephawuliwe lapho inomthombo.
rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Sunrise Solo, ha feela sebaka sa ho hola se se na serame mme metsi a tswa. Netefatsa dikgwedi tsa wona tsa kotulo sebakeng; khalendara e sebedisa tshupiso ya sebaka e tshwailweng moo ho nang le mohlodi.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Sunrise Solo, loko ndhawu yo kula yi pfumala rharhama naswona mati ya huma. Tiyisisa tin’hweti ta wona to tshovela endhawini; khalendara yi tirhisa xikombo xa xifundzha lexi funghiweke laha ku nga ni xihlovo.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Sunrise Solo, arali fhethu ha u aluwa hu si na murotholo nahone maḓi a bva. Khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi yalwo ya u kaṋa henefho; khalenda i shumisa ndaedzi ya dzingu yo vhewaho dzina hune tshiko tsha vha hone.

rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Tommy Atkins, ho ya ka ditlhahlobo tsa dipalesa le serame sebakeng. Netefatsa dikgwedi tsa wona tsa kotulo sebakeng; khalendara e sebedisa tshupiso ya sebaka e tshwailweng moo ho nang le mohlodi.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Tommy Atkins, hi ku ya hi minkambelo ya ku rhumbuka ni rharhama ya ndhawu. Tiyisisa tin’hweti ta wona to tshovela endhawini; khalendara yi tirhisa xikombo xa xifundzha lexi funghiweke laha ku nga ni xihlovo.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Tommy Atkins, u ya nga u ṱola maluvha na murotholo wa henefho. Khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi yalwo ya u kaṋa henefho; khalenda i shumisa ndaedzi ya dzingu yo vhewaho dzina hune tshiko tsha vha hone.

rows.zu: Iseluleko sokuthenga: alukho uhlobo olunegama lwale ndawo olunomthombo. Qinisekisa uhlobo, impova nokufaneleka endaweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Keletso ya ho reka: ha ho mohlodi wa mofuta o bitswang ka lebitso bakeng sa sebaka sena. Netefatsa mofuta, ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa le ho lokela ha sebaka pele o reka.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo xo xava: a ku na xihlovo xa muxaka lowu nga ni vito wa ndhawu leyi. Tiyisisa muxaka, ku hundziseriwa ka pholeni ni ku faneleka ka ndhawu u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: lushaka lu re na dzina lwa fhethu hafha a lu na tshiko. Khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, u phaḓaladzwa ha muvhere na u tea ha fhethu ni sa athu u renga.

rows.english: Choose the product and actual stock before planning output. Match stock to the local feed, climate, water and care capacity.
rows.zu: Khetha umkhiqizo nezilwane zangempela ngaphambi kokuhlela okuzokhiqizwa. Fanisa izilwane nokudla kwendawo, isimo sezulu, amanzi namandla okunakekela.
rows.st: Kgetha sehlahiswa le diphoofolo tsa nnete pele o rera tlhahiso. Bapisa diphoofolo le dijo tsa sebaka, maemo a lehodimo, metsi le bokgoni ba tlhokomelo.
rows.ts: Hlawula xikumiwa ni swifuwo swa xiviri u nga si kunguhata vuhumelerisi. Fananisa swifuwo ni swakudya swa ndhawu, maxelo, mati ni vuswikoti byo hlayisa.
rows.ve: Nangani tshibveledzwa na zwifuwo zwa vhukuma ni sa athu u pulana mvelelo. Yelanyisani zwifuwo na furu ya henefho, kilima, maḓi na vhukoni ha ṱhogomelo.

rows.english: Buying advice: for egg production, request vaccinated point-of-lay pullets from a layer supplier, with age, feeding and vaccination records.
rows.zu: Iseluleko sokuthenga: ukukhiqiza amaqanda, cela izikhukhukazi ezincane ezigonyiwe esezizozalela kumhlinzeki wezinkukhu ezizalelayo, namarekhodi eminyaka, ukudla nokugonywa.
rows.st: Keletso ya ho reka: bakeng sa tlhahiso ya mahe, kopa dikgoho tse nyane tse entilweng tse haufi le ho behela ho mofani wa dikgoho tse behelang, ka direkoto tsa dilemo, phepo le ente.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo xo xava: leswaku u humelerisa matandza, kombela tihuku letitsongo leti tlhaveriweke leti nga ekusuhi ni ku sungula ku tshikela eka muphakeri wa tihuku to tshikela, ni tirhekhodo ta vukhale, swakudya ni ku tlhaveriwa.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: u bveledza makumba, humbelani khuhu ṱhukhu dzo haelwaho dzi re tsini na u thoma u kudzela kha muṋetshedzi wa khuhu dzi kudzelaho, na rekhodo dza vhukale, u fhiwa zwiḽiwa na u haelwa.

rows.english: Buying advice: choose a meat strain and supplier batch plan; confirm brooding, feed, water and slaughter arrangements.
rows.zu: Iseluleko sokuthenga: khetha uhlobo lwenyama nohlelo lwamaqoqo lomhlinzeki; qinisekisa ukufudumeza amachwane, ukudla, amanzi nezinhlelo zokuhlaba.
rows.st: Keletso ya ho reka: kgetha mofuta wa nama le moralo wa dihlopha wa mofani; netefatsa kgodiso ya ditsuonyana ka mofuthu, dijo, metsi le ditokisetso tsa ho hlaba.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo xo xava: hlawula muxaka wa nyama ni kungu ra mintlawa ra muphakeri; tiyisisa ku kufumeta swinkukwana, swakudya, mati ni malunghiselelo yo tlhava.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: nangani lushaka lwa ṋama na pulane ya zwigwada ya muṋetshedzi; khwaṱhisedzani u dudedza zwikukwana, zwiḽiwa, maḓi na ndugiselelo dza u ṱhavha.

rows.english: Buying advice: match breed/stock to the product, local feed, climate and care capacity; confirm with a local livestock or beekeeping adviser.
rows.zu: Iseluleko sokuthenga: fanisa uhlobo/izilwane nomkhiqizo, ukudla kwendawo, isimo sezulu namandla okunakekela; qinisekisa nomeluleki wendawo wemfuyo noma wokufuywa kwezinyosi.
rows.st: Keletso ya ho reka: bapisa mofuta/diphoofolo le sehlahiswa, dijo tsa sebaka, maemo a lehodimo le bokgoni ba tlhokomelo; netefatsa le moeletsi wa sebaka wa mehlape kapa dinotshi.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo xo xava: fananisa muxaka/swifuwo ni xikumiwa, swakudya swa ndhawu, maxelo ni vuswikoti byo hlayisa; tiyisisa ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu wa swifuwo kumbe ku fuwa tinyoxi.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: yelanyisani lushaka/zwifuwo na tshibveledzwa, furu ya henefho, kilima na vhukoni ha ṱhogomelo; khwaṱhisedzani na mueletshedzi wa henefho wa zwifuwo kana u fuwa ṋotshi.

rows.english: Plan balanced feed, clean water, shade, ventilation and predator protection. Egg supply depends on laying birds, their age, health and care; a coop alone supplies no eggs.
rows.zu: Hlela ukudla okunomsoco olinganiselwe, amanzi ahlanzekile, umthunzi, umoya nokuvikelwa ezilwaneni ezidlayo. Ukutholakala kwamaqanda kuncike ezinkukhwini ezizalelayo, ubudala bazo, impilo nokunakekelwa; ihhoko lodwa alinikezi amaqanda.
rows.st: Rera dijo tse leka-lekaneng, metsi a hlwekileng, moriti, moya le tshireletso ho dibatana. Phepelo ya mahe e itshetlehile ka dinonyana tse behelang, dilemo tsa tsona, bophelo le tlhokomelo; hoko feela ha e fane ka mahe.
rows.ts: Kunguhata swakudya leswi ringanisiweke, mati yo tenga, ndzhuti, ku nghena ka moya ni nsirhelelo eka swihadyana leswi dlayaka. Mphakelo wa matandza wu titshege hi tihuku leti tshikelaka, vukhale bya tona, rihanyo ni nhlayiso; hoko yi ri yoxe a yi nyiki matandza.
rows.ve: Pulanani zwiḽiwa zwo linganelaho, maḓi o kunaho, murunzi, muya na tsireledzo kha zwipuka zwi ḽaho zwiṅwe. Mphakelo wa makumba u ḓitika nga khuhu dzi kudzelaho, vhukale hadzo, mutakalo na ṱhogomelo; hoko i yoṱhe a i ṋei makumba.

rows.english: Collect eggs frequently, keep nest litter clean and dry, and handle/store eggs carefully for household use or sale.
rows.zu: Qoqa amaqanda njalo, ugcine okwandlalwe ezidlekeni kuhlanzekile futhi komile, uphathe/ugcine amaqanda ngokucophelela ukuze asetshenziswe ekhaya noma athengiswe.
rows.st: Bokella mahe kgafetsa, boloka moo dihlaha di alwang ho hlwekile ho omme, mme o tshware/boloke mahe ka hloko bakeng sa tshebediso ya lelapa kapa thekiso.
rows.ts: Hlengeleta matandza nkarhi ni nkarhi, hlayisa leswi andlariweke eswisakeni swi tengile naswona swi omile, khoma/hlayisa matandza hi vukheta leswaku ma tirhisiwa ekaya kumbe ku xavisiwa.
rows.ve: Kuvhanganyani makumba tshifhinga tshoṱhe, vhulungani vhualo ha zwiṱaha ho kuna ho oma, ni fare/vhulunge makumba nga vhulondi u shumiswa muṱani kana u rengiswa.

rows.english: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
rows.zu: Hlela ngokuzala kwangempela kwamathole/amazinyane nokuncelisa. Izilwane ezingancelisi azinikezi ubisi.
rows.st: Rera ho ya ka ho tswala ha nnete ha manamane/madinyane le nako ya lebese. Diphoofolo tse sa hlahiseng lebese ha di fane ka lona.
rows.ts: Kunguhata hi ku ya hi ku tswariwa ka xiviri ka marhole/swimbutana ni ku humesa masi. Swifuwo leswi nga humesiki masi a swi nyiki masi.
rows.ve: Pulanani u ya nga u bebiwa ha vhukuma ha ṋamana/zwibudzana na u mamisa. Zwifuwo zwi sa mamisaho a zwi ṋei mafhi.

rows.english: Harvest depends on the colony, local flowering and rainfall. Inspect ripeness and leave food for the colony; there is no fixed national honey season.
rows.zu: Ukuvuna kuncike eqoqweni lezinyosi, ukuqhakaza nemvula endaweni. Hlola ukuvuthwa ushiyele iqoqo ukudla; asikho isikhathi sezwe lonke esinqunyiwe sokuvuna uju.
rows.st: Kotulo e itshetlehile ka sehlopha sa dinotshi, dipalesa le pula ya sebaka. Hlahloba ho butswa mme o siele dinotshi dijo; ha ho nako e tsitsitseng ya naha ya mahe a dinotshi.
rows.ts: Ntshovelo wu titshege hi ntlawa wa tinyoxi, ku rhumbuka ni mpfula ya ndhawu. Kambela ku vupfa u siyela ntlawa swakudya; a ku na nguva ya vulombe leyi vekiweke ya tiko hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Khaṋo i ḓitika nga tshigwada tsha ṋotshi, maluvha na mvula ya henefho. Ṱolani u vhibva ni siele tshigwada zwiḽiwa; a hu na khalaṅwaha yo tiwaho ya lushaka ya mutoli.

rows.ve: Vhukale ha khuhu u bva i tshi thothonywa; khwaṱhisedzani lushaka na u aluswa na muṋetshedzi. Khuhu dzi re tsini na u kudzela dzi thoma nga murahu kha mutevhe uyu.

rows.ts: Kambela swilaveko swa pholeni swa muxaka wa xiviri. Ndzingo wa masungulo wu katsa swimilana leswi amukelaka pholeni ya swona ni leswi nga yi amukeliki.

rows.english: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
rows.zu: Rekhoda izinsuku zendawo zokuvuna izithelo ezivuthiwe nokukhiqizwayo. Izikhathi zezinhlobo zakwamanye amazwe azifakazeli isikhathi sokuvuna saseNingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Rekota matsatsi a sebaka a ho kotula ditholwana tse butswitseng le tlhahiso. Dinako tsa mefuta ya dinaheng tse ding ha di tiise nako ya kotulo ya Afrika Borwa.
rows.ts: Rhekhoda masiku ya ndhawu yo tshovela mihandzu leyi vupfeke ni vuhumelerisi. Tinguva ta tinxaka ta le matikweni mambe a ti tiyisisi nguva ya Afrika Dzonga.
rows.ve: Rekhodani maḓuvha a henefho a u kaṋa mitshelo yo vhibvaho na mvelelo. Khalaṅwaha dza tshaka dza mashango a nnḓa a dzi khwaṱhisedzi khalaṅwaha ya Afrika Tshipembe.

rows.english: Ask the nursery to name the cultivar or identify a seedling and provide local fruiting and compatible-pollen evidence. 'Fruit Salad Tree' is a common sales label and does not identify a tested cultivar.
rows.zu: Cela inkulisa yezitshalo ukuthi isho igama lohlobo noma ihlonze isithombo, inikeze nobufakazi bendawo bokuthela nempova ehambisanayo. 'Fruit Salad Tree' yigama elivamile lokuthengisa futhi alisho uhlobo oluhloliwe.
rows.st: Kopa sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela ho bolela lebitso la mofuta kapa ho hlwaya sethopo le ho fana ka bopaki ba sebaka ba ho beha ditholwana le peo ya dipalesa e tsamaisanang. 'Fruit Salad Tree' ke lebitso le tlwaelehileng la thekiso mme ha le hlwaye mofuta o lekilweng.
rows.ts: Kombela ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana ku vula vito ra muxaka kumbe ku tiva xithlabyana ni ku nyika vumbhoni bya ndhawu bya ku veka mihandzu ni pholeni leyi fambelanaka. 'Fruit Salad Tree' i vito leri tolovelekeke ro xavisa naswona a ri vuli muxaka lowu ringetiweke.
rows.ve: Humbelani nesari uri i bule dzina ḽa lushaka kana i ṱalule tshithuṅu nahone i ṋee vhuṱanzi ha henefho ha u aṋwa mitshelo na muvhere u yelanaho. 'Fruit Salad Tree' ndi dzina ḽo ḓoweleaho ḽa u rengisa nahone a ḽi ṱaluli lushaka lwo lingwaho.

rows.english: Primary Brazilian germplasm experiment found both compatibility classes. Biological evidence supports checking the actual cultivar and compatible pollen, not assigning one universal species category or copying its calendar to South Africa.
rows.zu: Ucwaningo oluyisisekelo lwaseBrazil lwezinto zofuzo (germplasm) lwathola zombili izinhlobo zokuhambisana kwempova. Ubufakazi besayensi yezinto eziphilayo busekela ukuhlola uhlobo lwangempela nempova ehambisanayo, hhayi ukubeka lonke lolu hlobo lwezitshalo esigabeni esisodwa noma ukukopisha ikhalenda lalo eNingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Teko ya mantlha ya Brazil ya disebediswa tsa lefutso (germplasm) e fumane dihlopha ka bobedi tsa ho tsamaisana ha peo ya dipalesa. Bopaki ba baeloji bo tshehetsa ho hlahloba mofuta wa nnete le peo ya dipalesa e tsamaisanang, eseng ho abela mofuta wohle wa semela sehlopha se le seng kapa ho kopitsa khalendara ya wona Afrika Borwa.
rows.ts: Ndzingo wa masungulo wa le Brazil wa switirhisiwa swa majini (germplasm) wu kume mintlawa yimbirhi ya ku fambelana ka pholeni. Vumbhoni bya bayoloji byi seketela ku kambela muxaka wa xiviri ni pholeni leyi fambelanaka, ku nga ri ku veka muxaka wa ximilana hinkwaxo eka ntlawa wun’we kumbe ku kopela khalendara ya wona eAfrika Dzonga.
rows.ve: Mulingo wa u thoma wa Brazil wa zwishumiswa zwa dzimajini (germplasm) wo wana zwigwada zwoṱhe zwivhili zwa u yelana ha muvhere. Vhuṱanzi ha bayolodzhi vhu tikedza u ṱola lushaka lwa vhukuma na muvhere u yelanaho, hu si u vhea lushaka lwoṱhe lwa tshimela kha tshigwada tshithihi kana u kopela khalenda yatsho kha Afrika Tshipembe.

rows.ve: Muvhuso u khwaṱhisedza uri ARC yo lingulula feijoa; u buliwa uhu a hu ṋei mvelelo ya mulingo, lushaka, ṅwedzi wa khaṋo kana khaṋo.

rows.st: Fumana dimela tsa sebaka sa kgodiso tse hlwauweng ka nepo, tse molaong, le keletso ya ho hodisa sebakeng. Ha ho mofuta wa chai ya dijo kapa mothinya wa ho hola ho fihlela tlhahisong o netefaditsweng.
rows.ts: Kuma swimilana swa ndhawu yo kurisa leswi tivekaka kahle naswona swi nga enawini ni switsundzuxo swa ku kurisa endhawini. A ku na muxaka wa ntshovelo wa swakudya kumbe girafu ya ku kula ku fika eku humeleriseni leyi tiyisisiweke.
rows.ve: Wanani zwimela zwa nesari zwo ṱalulwaho zwavhuḓi zwi re mulayoni na nyeletshedzo ya u alusa henefho. A hu na lushaka lwa khaṋo ya zwiḽiwa kana tshati ya u aluwa u swika kha u bveledza yo khwaṱhisedzwaho.

rows.english: The edible product is the young flower bud. June–July flowering does not establish the exact pre-opening picking dates, first bud-bearing age or edible kg/plant.
rows.zu: Umkhiqizo odliwayo yimbali encane engakavuleki. Ukuqhakaza ngoJuni–Julayi akufakazeli izinsuku eziqondile zokuvuna ngaphambi kokuvuleka, ubudala bokuqala bokuba nezimbali ezingakavuleki noma ama-kg/plant adliwayo.
rows.st: Sehlahiswa se jewang ke palesa e nyane e so kang e buleha. Ho thunya ka Phupjane–Phupu ha ho tiise matsatsi a tobileng a kotulo pele dipalesa di buleha, dilemo tsa pele tsa ho ba le dipalesa tse so kang di buleha kapa kg/plant e jewang.
rows.ts: Xikumiwa lexi dyiwaka i bilomu leritsongo leri nga si pfulekaka. Ku rhumbuka hi Khotavuxika–Mawuwani a ku tiyisisi masiku yo tshovela lama kongomeke ya loko ma nga si pfuleka, vukhale byo sungula ku va ni mabilomu lama nga si pfulekaka kumbe kg/plant leyi dyiwaka.
rows.ve: Tshibveledzwa tshi ḽiwaho ndi luvha ḽiṱuku ḽi sa athu u vuleaho. U ṱuma maluvha nga Fulwi–Fulwana a zwi khwaṱhisedzi maḓuvha a vhukuma a u kaṋa hu sa athu u vulea, vhukale ha u thoma u vha na maluvha a sa athu u vuleaho kana kg/plant i ḽiwaho.

rows.english: Pineapple fruit; whole fruit and processed portions have different weights.
rows.zu: Izithelo zikaphayinaphu; izithelo eziphelele nezingxenye ezicutshunguliwe zinezisindo ezihlukene.
rows.st: Ditholwana tsa phaenapole; ditholwana tse felletseng le dikarolo tse sebetsitsweng di na le boima bo fapaneng.
rows.ts: Mihandzu ya xihenge; mihandzu leyi heleleke ni swiphemu leswi lulamisiweke swi ni mintiko yo hambana.
rows.ve: Mitshelo ya tshienge; mitshelo yo fhelelaho na zwipiḓa zwo lugiswaho zwi na zwileme zwo fhambanaho.

rows.english: Use a warm, frost-free, well-drained site. The KZN production reference is Hluhluwe; it does not establish suitability throughout South Africa.
rows.zu: Sebenzisa indawo efudumele, engenasithwathwa namanzi aphuma kahle emhlabathini. Inkomba yokukhiqiza yase-KZN ingeyaseHluhluwe; ayifakazeli ukufaneleka kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Sebedisa sebaka se futhumetseng, se se nang serame seo metsi a tswang hantle mobung. Tshupiso ya tlhahiso ya KZN ke ya Hluhluwe; ha e tiise ho lokela Afrika Borwa ka bophara.
rows.ts: Tirhisa ndhawu yo kufumela, leyi nga riki na rharhama ni leyi mati ya humaka kahle emhlabeni. Xikombo xa vuhumelerisi xa KZN i xa Hluhluwe; a xi tiyisisi ku faneleka eAfrika Dzonga hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Shumisani fhethu hu dudelaho, hu si na murotholo, hune maḓi a bva zwavhuḓi mavuni. Ndaedzi ya vhubveledzi ya KZN ndi ya Hluhluwe; a i khwaṱhisedzi uri zwi tea Afrika Tshipembe ḽoṱhe.

rows.english: Record planting and actual picking dates. Year-round commercial planting or marketing does not mean every planted pineapple gives fruit in every month.
rows.zu: Rekhoda izinsuku zokutshala nezokuphuma ngempela kwesivuno. Ukutshala noma ukuthengisa kwezohwebo unyaka wonke akusho ukuthi uphayinaphu ngamunye otshaliwe ukhiqiza izithelo njalo ngenyanga.
rows.st: Rekota matsatsi a ho jala le a kotulo ya nnete. Ho jala kapa ho rekisa ka kgwebo selemo kaofela ha ho bolele hore phaenapole e nngwe le e nngwe e jetsweng e beha ditholwana kgwedi e nngwe le e nngwe.
rows.ts: Rhekhoda masiku yo byala ni yo tshovela ya xiviri. Ku byala kumbe ku xavisa hi bindzu lembe hinkwaro a swi vuli leswaku xihenge xin’wana ni xin’wana lexi byariweke xi nyika mihandzu hi n’hweti yin’wana ni yin’wana.
rows.ve: Rekhodani maḓuvha a u ṱavha na a u kaṋa a vhukuma. U ṱavha kana u rengisa nga vhubindudzi ṅwaha woṱhe a zwi ambi uri tshienge tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsho ṱavhiwaho tshi aṋwa mitshelo ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe.

rows.english: KZN guide: Queen is a fresh-fruit candidate; Smooth Cayenne is mainly a processing candidate. Confirm clean crowns/suckers, local suitability and crop-cycle advice with a nursery. Queen re-establishment after the plant crop belongs in the future plan.
rows.zu: Umhlahlandlela wase-KZN: i-Queen iyinketho yezithelo ezintsha; i-Smooth Cayenne ikakhulukazi iyinketho yokucutshungulwa. Qinisekisa iziqongo/amahlumela ahlanzekile, ukufaneleka endaweni nezeluleko zomjikelezo wesitshalo nenkulisa yezitshalo. Ukuvuselelwa kwe-Queen ngemva kwesivuno sesitshalo sokuqala kufanele kufakwe ohlelweni oluzayo.
rows.st: Tataiso ya KZN: Queen ke kgetho ya ditholwana tse foreshe; Smooth Cayenne haholo ke kgetho ya ho sebetswa. Netefatsa dihloho/mahlomela a hlwekileng, ho lokela ha sebaka le keletso ya potoloho ya sejalo le sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela. Ho jala Queen hape ka mora kotulo ya semela sa pele ho lokela ho kenngwa moralong o tlang.
rows.ts: Nkongomiso wa KZN: Queen i xihlawuriwa xa mihandzu yo basa; Smooth Cayenne ngopfu i xihlawuriwa xa ku lulamisiwa. Tiyisisa tinhloko/mahluke yo tenga, ku faneleka ka ndhawu ni switsundzuxo swa ndzhendzeleko wa xibyariwa ni ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana. Ku tlhela u byala Queen endzhaku ka ntshovelo wa ximilana xo sungula swi fanele ku va eka kungu leri taka.
rows.ve: Nyendedzi ya KZN: Queen ndi zwa u nanga zwa mitshelo miswa; Smooth Cayenne kanzhi ndi zwa u nanga zwa u lugiswa. Khwaṱhisedzani ṱhoho/makhule o kunaho, u tea ha fhethu na nyeletshedzo ya mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa na nesari. U ṱavhulula Queen nga murahu ha khaṋo ya tshimela tsha u thoma zwi tea u katelwa kha pulane i ḓaho.

rows.english: Hluhluwe crop-cycle output
rows.zu: Ukukhiqiza komjikelezo wesitshalo waseHluhluwe
rows.st: Tlhahiso ya potoloho ya sejalo ya Hluhluwe
rows.ts: Vuhumelerisi bya ndzhendzeleko wa xibyariwa wa Hluhluwe
rows.ve: Mvelelo ya mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa ya Hluhluwe

rows.english: Regional hectare reference: conservative 50 t/ha, average 60–75 t/ha, good 80 t/ha per production crop. The same page describes a normal 18-month Hluhluwe cycle. These are not kg/plant/year or a forecast for a household planting.
rows.zu: Inkomba yesifunda ngehektare: ngokucophelela 50 t/ha, ngokwesilinganiso 60–75 t/ha, okuhle 80 t/ha ngesivuno somjikelezo ngamunye. Ikhasi elifanayo lichaza umjikelezo ojwayelekile waseHluhluwe wezinyanga ezingu-18. Lokhu akuwona ama-kg/plant/year noma isibikezelo sokutshalwe ekhaya.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya sebaka ka hektare: kakanyo e hlokolosi 50 t/ha, karolelano 60–75 t/ha, tlhahiso e ntle 80 t/ha ka kotulo ya potoloho ka nngwe. Leqephe leo le hlalosa potoloho e tlwaelehileng ya Hluhluwe ya dikgwedi tse 18. Tsena ha se kg/plant/year kapa ponelopele ya temo ya lelapa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa xifundzha hi hekitara: mpimo wo hlayiseka 50 t/ha, mpimo wa le xikarhini 60–75 t/ha, lowunene 80 t/ha eka ntshovelo wun’wana ni wun’wana wa ndzhendzeleko. Pheji rero ri hlamusela ndzhendzeleko wa ntolovelo wa Hluhluwe wa tin’hweti ta 18. Leyi a hi kg/plant/year kumbe mvhumbo wa leswi byariweke ekaya.
rows.ve: Ndaedzi ya dzingu nga hekhithara: tshikalo tsha vhulondi 50 t/ha, tshikati 60–75 t/ha, tshavhuḓi 80 t/ha kha khaṋo ya mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe. Siaṱari ḽeneḽo ḽi ṱalutshedza mutevhe wo ḓoweleaho wa Hluhluwe wa miṅwedzi ya 18. Izwi a si kg/plant/year kana mbonelaphanḓa ya zwo ṱavhiwaho zwa muṱa.

rows.english: Cultivar and renewal choice
rows.zu: Ukukhetha uhlobo nokuvuselela
rows.st: Kgetho ya mofuta le ho qala hape
rows.ts: Ku hlawula muxaka ni ku sungula nakambe
rows.ve: U nanga lushaka na u vusuludza

rows.english: Queen and Smooth Cayenne serve different uses. The guide's example fruit weights (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) are cultivar descriptions, not annual yields per plant. Queen is re-established after the plant crop in this system.
rows.zu: I-Queen ne-Smooth Cayenne zisetshenziselwa izinto ezihlukene. Izisindo zezithelo eziyizibonelo ezisemhlahlandleleni (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) zichaza izinhlobo, azizona izivuno zonyaka zesitshalo ngasinye. Kulesi simiso i-Queen iphinde itshalwe ngemva kwesivuno sesitshalo sokuqala.
rows.st: Queen le Smooth Cayenne di sebedisetswa dintho tse fapaneng. Mehlala ya boima ba ditholwana tataisong (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) ke ditlhaloso tsa mefuta, eseng chai ya selemo ka semela. Queen e lengwa hape ka mora kotulo ya semela sa pele mokgweng ona.
rows.ts: Queen na Smooth Cayenne swi tirhisiwa eka swilo swo hambana. Swikombiso swa mintiko ya mihandzu eka nkongomiso (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) i tinhlamuselo ta tinxaka, ku nga ri ntshovelo wa lembe hi ximilana. Queen yi tlhela yi byariwa endzhaku ka ntshovelo wa ximilana xo sungula eka endlelo leri.
rows.ve: Queen na Smooth Cayenne zwi shumiswa kha zwithu zwo fhambanaho. Zwileme zwa tsumbo zwa mitshelo kha nyendedzi (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) ndi ṱhalutshedzo dza tshaka, hu si khaṋo dza ṅwaha nga tshimela. Queen i ṱavhululwa nga murahu ha khaṋo ya tshimela tsha u thoma kha sisṱeme iyi.

rows.english: Climate and calendar conditions
rows.zu: Izimo zezulu nezekhalenda
rows.st: Maemo a lehodimo le a khalendara
rows.ts: Swiyimo swa maxelo ni khalendara
rows.ve: Nyimele dza kilima na khalenda

rows.english: Frost sensitivity and drainage constrain the site. Year-round planting at Hluhluwe is a planting reference, not an all-year household picking window; cooler sites use warmer planting months.
rows.zu: Ukuzwela esithwathweni nokuphuma kwamanzi emhlabathini kunqanda ukufaneleka kwendawo. Ukutshala unyaka wonke eHluhluwe kuyinkomba yokutshala, hhayi isikhathi sokuvuna sasekhaya sonyaka wonke; izindawo ezipholile zisebenzisa izinyanga ezifudumele zokutshala.
rows.st: Ho tshaba serame le phallo ya metsi mobung di lekanyetsa sebaka. Ho jala selemo kaofela Hluhluwe ke tshupiso ya ho jala, eseng nako ya kotulo ya lelapa ya selemo kaofela; dibaka tse phodileng di sebedisa dikgwedi tse futhumetseng tsa ho jala.
rows.ts: Ku nga tiyiseli rharhama ni ku huma ka mati emhlabeni swi pima ku faneleka ka ndhawu. Ku byala lembe hinkwaro eHluhluwe i xikombo xa ku byala, ku nga ri nkarhi wo tshovela wa le kaya wa lembe hinkwaro; tindhawu to titimela ti tirhisa tin’hweti to kufumela to byala.
rows.ve: U sa konḓelela murotholo na u bva ha maḓi mavuni zwi pima u tea ha fhethu. U ṱavha ṅwaha woṱhe ngei Hluhluwe ndi ndaedzi ya u ṱavha, hu si tshifhinga tsha muṱa tsha u kaṋa ṅwaha woṱhe; fhethu hu rotholelaho hu shumisa miṅwedzi i dudelaho ya u ṱavha.

rows.english: flowers and flower buds
rows.zu: izimbali nezimbali ezingakavuleki
rows.st: dipalesa le dipalesa tse so kang di buleha
rows.ts: mabilomu ni mabilomu lama nga si pfulekaka
rows.ve: maluvha na maluvha a sa athu u vuleaho

rows.english: Start tubers in loam in shallow pond water; move deeper into sun after strong growth.
rows.zu: Qala izigaxa emhlabathini wohlobo lwe-loam emanzini echibi angajulile; hambisa ekujuleni nasekukhanyeni kwelanga ngemva kokukhula ngamandla.
rows.st: Qala digwere mobung wa loam metsing a sa tebang a letangwana; di ise botebong le letsatsing ka mora kgolo e matla.
rows.ts: Sungula swirhumbana eka misava ya loam ematini yo ka ma nga entanga ya xidziva; swi yise laha ku enteke ni le dyambyini endzhaku ka ku kula hi nguvu.
rows.ve: Thomani makanda kha mavu a loam kha maḓi a tshivhudu a sa tsaho; zwi iseni hune ha tsa na kha ḓuvha nga murahu ha nyaluwo yo khwaṱhaho.

rows.english: Record edible flowers/buds and pond area. Dormant tubers resume growth as autumn water returns in the winter-rainfall cycle.
rows.zu: Rekhoda izimbali/izimbali ezingakavuleki ezidliwayo nobukhulu bendawo yechibi. Izigaxa ezilele ziqala futhi ukukhula lapho amanzi ebuya ekwindla emjikelezweni wemvula yasebusika.
rows.st: Rekota dipalesa/dipalesa tse so kang di buleha tse jewang le boholo ba letangwana. Digwere tse phomotseng di qala ho hola hape ha metsi a kgutla ka hwetla potolohong ya pula ya mariha.
rows.ts: Rhekhoda mabilomu/mabilomu lama nga si pfulekaka lama dyiwaka ni vukulu bya xidziva. Swirhumbana leswi wiseke swi tlhela swi kula loko mati ma vuya hi xixikana eka ndzhendzeleko wa mpfula ya vuxika.
rows.ve: Rekhodani maluvha/maluvha a sa athu u vuleaho a ḽiwaho na vhuhulwane ha tshivhudu. Makanda o eḓelaho a dovha a aluwa musi maḓi a tshi vhuya nga tshifhefho kha mutevhe wa mvula ya vhuria.

rows.english: Obtain correctly identified pond plants. Confirm local pond conditions and actual picking dates; no pond-area yield or planting density is sourced.
rows.zu: Thola izitshalo zechibi ezikhonjwe kahle. Qinisekisa izimo zechibi lendawo nezinsuku zangempela zokuvuna; awukho umthombo wesivuno ngobukhulu bechibi noma ukuminyana kokutshala.
rows.st: Fumana dimela tsa letangwana tse hlwauweng ka nepo. Netefatsa maemo a letangwana la sebaka le matsatsi a nnete a kotulo; ha ho mohlodi wa chai ka boholo ba letangwana kapa palo ya ho jala ka sebaka.
rows.ts: Kuma swimilana swa xidziva leswi tivekaka kahle. Tiyisisa swiyimo swa xidziva xa ndhawu ni masiku ya xiviri yo tshovela; a ku na xihlovo xa ntshovelo hi vukulu bya xidziva kumbe ntlimbano wa ku byala.
rows.ve: Wanani zwimela zwa tshivhudu zwo ṱalulwaho zwavhuḓi. Khwaṱhisedzani nyimele dza tshivhudu tsha henefho na maḓuvha a u kaṋa a vhukuma; a hu na tshiko tsha khaṋo nga vhuhulwane ha tshivhudu kana tshivhalo tsha zwimela nga tshikhala.

rows.english: Waterblommetjie food product and establishment
rows.zu: Umkhiqizo wokudla we-Waterblommetjie nokuqalisa ukukhulisa
rows.st: Sehlahiswa sa dijo sa Waterblommetjie le ho qala kgodiso
rows.ts: Xikumiwa xa swakudya xa Waterblommetjie ni ku sungula ku kurisa
rows.ve: Tshibveledzwa tsha zwiḽiwa tsha Waterblommetjie na u thoma u alusa

rows.english: Western Cape pond food; vigorous winter/spring flowering and winter shop availability are qualitative seasonal evidence, not a numeric picking calendar. Seedlings reach flowering size in one season under ideal conditions, not a universal age-in-years guarantee.
rows.zu: Ukudla kwechibi kwase-Western Cape; ukuqhakaza okunamandla ebusika/entwasahlobo nokutholakala ezitolo ebusika kuwubufakazi besikhathi obuchazayo, hhayi ikhalenda lokuvuna elinezinombolo. Izithombo zifinyelela ebukhulwini bokuqhakaza ngesizini eyodwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, hhayi isiqinisekiso sobudala beminyaka obusebenza yonke indawo.
rows.st: Dijo tsa letangwana tsa Western Cape; dipalesa tse ngata mariha/selemo le boteng mabenkeleng mariha ke bopaki bo hlalosang nako, eseng khalendara ya kotulo ya dipalo. Dithopo di fihla boholong ba ho thunya sehleng se le seng tlasa maemo a loketseng, eseng tiiso ya dilemo e sebetsang hohle.
rows.ts: Swakudya swa xidziva swa Western Cape; ku rhumbuka hi nguvu hi vuxika/ximun’wana ni ku kumeka emavhengeleni hi vuxika i vumbhoni byo hlamusela nguva, ku nga ri khalendara yo tshovela leyi nga ni tinhlayo. Switlabyana swi fika eka vukulu byo rhumbuka hi nguva yin’we ehansi ka swiyimo leswinene, ku nga ri xitshembiso xa vukhale hi malembe lexi tirhaka hinkwako.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwa tshivhudu zwa Western Cape; u ṱuma maluvha nga maanḓa nga vhuria/lutavula na u wanala mavhengeleni nga vhuria ndi vhuṱanzi vhu ṱalutshedzaho khalaṅwaha, hu si khalenda ya khaṋo ya zwivhalo. Zwithuṅu zwi swika kha vhuhulwane ha u ṱuma maluvha nga khalaṅwaha nthihi fhasi ha nyimele dzavhuḓi, hu si fulufhedziso ḽa vhukale nga miṅwaha ḽi shumaho fhethu hoṱhe.

rows.english: Ideal seedling establishment
rows.zu: Ukuqalisa izithombo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele
rows.st: Ho qala kgodiso ya dithopo tlasa maemo a loketseng
rows.ts: Ku sungula ku kurisa switlabyana ehansi ka swiyimo leswinene
rows.ve: U thoma u alusa zwithuṅu fhasi ha nyimele dzavhuḓi

rows.english: Qualitative ideal-condition establishment duration; it is not inserted into a generic tree-age curve.
rows.zu: Isikhathi esichazayo sokuqalisa ukukhulisa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele; asifakwa ejikeni elivamile lobudala bezihlahla.
rows.st: Nako e hlalosang ho qala kgodiso tlasa maemo a loketseng; ha e kenngwe mothinyeng o akaretsang wa dilemo tsa difate.
rows.ts: Nkarhi wo hlamusela ku sungula ku kurisa ehansi ka swiyimo leswinene; a wu nghenisiwi eka girafu ya ntolovelo ya vukhale bya mirhi.
rows.ve: Tshifhinga tshi ṱalutshedzaho u thoma u alusa fhasi ha nyimele dzavhuḓi; a tshi dzheniswi kha tshati ya vhukale ha miri yo ḓoweleaho.

rows.english: young shoots for dried rooibos tea
rows.zu: amahlumela amancane etiye le-rooibos elomisiwe
rows.st: mahlomela a manyane a tee ya rooibos e omisitsweng
rows.ts: mahluke lamatsongo ya tiya ya rooibos leyi omisiweke
rows.ve: makhule maṱuku a tie ya rooibos yo omiswaho

rows.english: Match planting to acidic, sandy winter-rainfall soils and locally suitable rooibos forms.
rows.zu: Fanisa ukutshala nomhlabathi onesimuncu, oyisihlabathi nowemvula yasebusika, kanye nezinhlobo ze-rooibos ezifanele indawo.
rows.st: Bapisa ho jala le mobu o esiti, o lehlabathe wa pula ya mariha le mefuta ya rooibos e loketseng sebaka.
rows.ts: Fananisa ku byala ni misava ya asidi, ya sava ya mpfula ya vuxika ni tinxaka ta rooibos leti faneleke ndhawu.
rows.ve: Yelanyisani u ṱavha na mavu a esidi, a muṱavha a mvula ya vhuria na tshaka dza rooibos dzi teaho henefho.

rows.english: Keep fresh-cut shoot weights separate from processed dried tea; record the actual processing output.
rows.zu: Gcina izisindo zamahlumela asanda kusikwa ngokwehlukana netiye elicutshunguliwe nelomisiwe; rekhoda okukhiqizwe ngempela ngesikhathi sokucutshungulwa.
rows.st: Boloka boima ba mahlomela a sa tswa kguwa ka thoko ho tee e sebetsitsweng e omisitsweng; rekota tlhahiso ya nnete ya tshebetso.
rows.ts: Hlayisa mintiko ya mahluke lama ha ku tsemiwaka yi hambanile ni tiya leyi lulamisiweke yi omisiwile; rhekhoda mbuyelo wa xiviri wa ku lulamisa.
rows.ve: Vhulungani zwileme zwa makhule a kha ḓi tou bva u geriwa nga thungo ha tie yo lugiswaho yo omiswaho; rekhodani mvelelo ya vhukuma ya u lugisa.

rows.english: Ask a local rooibos nursery or adviser for correctly identified, locally proven planting material. The Cape cycle is not a nationwide tea forecast.
rows.zu: Buza inkulisa ye-rooibos yendawo noma umeluleki ngezinto zokutshala ezikhonjwe kahle nezihloliwe endaweni. Umjikelezo waseKapa awusona isibikezelo setiye sezwe lonke.
rows.st: Botsa sebaka sa kgodiso ya rooibos kapa moeletsi wa sebaka ka dimela tsa ho jala tse hlwauweng ka nepo, tse lekilweng sebakeng. Potoloho ya Kapa ha se ponelopele ya tee ya naha yohle.
rows.ts: Vutisa ndhawu yo kurisa rooibos kumbe mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu hi swilo swo byala leswi tivekaka kahle naswona swi tiyisisiweke endhawini. Ndzhendzeleko wa Kapa a hi mvhumbo wa tiya wa tiko hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Vhudzisani nesari ya rooibos kana mueletshedzi wa henefho nga zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha zwo ṱalulwaho zwavhuḓi zwo khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho. Mutevhe wa Kapa a si mbonelaphanḓa ya tie ya shango ḽoṱhe.

rows.english: Commercial tea cutting cycle and product
rows.zu: Umjikelezo wokusika itiye lezohwebo nomkhiqizo
rows.st: Potoloho ya kgwebo ya ho kga tee le sehlahiswa
rows.ts: Ndzhendzeleko wa ku tsema tiya ya bindzu ni xikumiwa
rows.ve: Mutevhe wa u gera tie ya vhubindudzi na tshibveledzwa

rows.english: Selected commercial rooibos forms in the Cederberg winter-rainfall region are cut annually December–April, retaining older branches. Cut shoots are chopped, bruised, oxidised and dried. Fresh shoot kg and dried tea kg are separate products. The account describes replacement after up to five harvest years, not a mature kg/plant curve.
rows.zu: Izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-rooibos yezohwebo esifundeni semvula yasebusika saseCederberg zisikwa minyaka yonke ngoDisemba–Ephreli, kugcinwe amagatsha amadala. Amahlumela asikiwe ayaqotshwa, agxotshwe, enziwe i-oxidation futhi omiswe. Ama-kg amahlumela amasha nama-kg etiye elomisiwe ayimikhiqizo ehlukene. Umbhalo uchaza ukubuyiselwa kwezitshalo ngemva kweminyaka yokuvuna engafika kwemihlanu, hhayi ijika lama-kg/plant esezikhule ngokugcwele.
rows.st: Mefuta e kgethilweng ya rooibos ya kgwebo sebakeng sa pula ya mariha sa Cederberg e kguwa selemo le selemo ka Tshitwe–Mmesa, ho siuwa makala a kgale. Mahlomela a kguilweng a a sehwa, a a silakanngwa, a fetolwa ka oxidation mme a omiswe. Kg tsa mahlomela a foreshe le kg tsa tee e omisitsweng ke dihlahiswa tse arohaneng. Tlaleho e hlalosa ho nkela dimela sebaka ka mora dilemo tsa kotulo tse fihlang ho tse hlano, eseng mothinya wa kg/plant e seng e hodile.
rows.ts: Tinxaka leti hlawuriweke ta rooibos ya bindzu exifundzheni xa mpfula ya vuxika xa Cederberg ti tsemiwa lembe ni lembe hi N'wendzamhala–Dzivamisoko, ku hlayisiwa marhavi ya khale. Mahluke lama tsemiweke ma tsemiwa matsongo, ma tshikeleriwa, ma endliwa oxidation ma tlhela ma omisiwa. Kg ta mahluke yo basa ni kg ta tiya leyi omisiweke i swikumiwa swo hambana. Xihlovo xi hlamusela ku siva swimilana endzhaku ka malembe yo tshovela yo fika eka ntlhanu, ku nga ri girafu ya kg/plant ya swimilana leswi kuleke.
rows.ve: Tshaka dzo nangwaho dza rooibos ya vhubindudzi kha dzingu ḽa mvula ya vhuria ḽa Cederberg dzi geriwa ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe nga Nyendavhusiku–Lambamai, hu tshi vhulungwa matavhi a kale. Makhule o geriwaho a a khethekanywa, a a pwashiwa, a itwa oxidation na u omiswa. Kg dza makhule maswa na kg dza tie yo omiswaho ndi zwibveledzwa zwo fhambanaho. Tshiko tshi ṱalutshedza u tshintsha zwimela nga murahu ha miṅwaha ya khaṋo i swikaho miṱanu, hu si tshati ya kg/plant ya zwimela zwo no hulaho.

rows.zu: Thenga izinto zohlobo olungaphansi kwezohlobo ezikhonjwe kahle. Rekhoda izinsuku zangempela zokusika amaqabunga nezisindo; alukho uhlobo lwesivuno lwendawo noma isikhathi sokuqala ukusika esiqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: Reka dimela tsa mofuta o ka tlase tse hlwauweng ka nepo. Rekota matsatsi a nnete a ho kga makgasi le boima; ha ho mofuta wa chai wa sebaka kapa nako ya pele ya ho kga e netefaditsweng.
rows.ts: Xava swimilana swa muxaka lowutsongo leswi tivekaka kahle. Rhekhoda masiku ya xiviri yo tsema matluka ni mintiko; a ku na muxaka wa ntshovelo wa ndhawu kumbe nkarhi wo tsema ro sungula lowu tiyisisiweke.
rows.ve: Rengani zwishumiswa zwa lushaka luṱuku zwo ṱalulwaho zwavhuḓi. Rekhodani maḓuvha a vhukuma a u gera maṱari na zwileme; a hu na lushaka lwa khaṋo ya henefho kana tshifhinga tsha u gera lwa u thoma zwo khwaṱhisedzwaho.

rows.st: Boloka sefate sena lethathamong la mmapa mme o se se bale e le dijo tsa lelapa ho fihlela ho hlahlobilwe hore ke semela sefe le tokiso e bolokehileng ya makgasi a jewang.
rows.ts: Hlayisa murhi lowu eka nxaxamelo wa mepe naswona u nga wu hlayeli eka swakudya swa le kaya ku kondza ku kambisisiwa leswaku i muxaka wihi ni malunghiselelo lama hlayisekeke ya matluka lama dyiwaka.
rows.ve: Vhulungani muri uyu kha mutevhe wa mapa ni si u vhalela sa zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa u swika hu tshi sedzuluswa vhuvha na u lugisela ho tsireledzeaho ha maṱari a ḽiwaho.

rows.english: SANBI describes humid coastal/estuarine conditions and no tolerance of even mild frost.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ichaza izimo zasogwini/ezasemlonyeni womfula ezinomswakama nokungakwazi ukumelana ngisho nesithwathwa esincane.
rows.st: SANBI e hlalosa maemo a mongobo a lebopo/a molomo wa noka le ho se mamelle esita le serame se fokolang.
rows.ts: SANBI yi hlamusela swiyimo swo tsakama swa ribuwana/swa laha nambu wu hlanganaka ni lwandle ni ku nga tiyiseli hambi ku ri rharhama ritsongo.
rows.ve: SANBI i ṱalutshedza nyimele dzo ṋukalaho dza tsini na lwanzhe/dza mulomo wa mulambo na u sa konḓelela na murotholo muṱuku.

rows.english: Ask a specialist nursery about lawful provenance and local site fit. Resolve the food-use question before purchasing it as a household crop.
rows.zu: Buza inkulisa yezitshalo eyingcweti ngemvelaphi esemthethweni nokufaneleka endaweni. Xazulula umbuzo wokusetshenziswa njengokudla ngaphambi kokusithenga njengesitshalo sokudla kwasekhaya.
rows.st: Botsa sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela sa setsebi ka mohlodi o molaong le ho lokela sebakeng. Rarolla taba ya tshebediso e le dijo pele o se reka e le sejalo sa lelapa.
rows.ts: Vutisa ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana ya mutivi hi masungulo lama nga enawini ni ku faneleka ka ndhawu. Lulamisa xivutiso xa ku tirhisiwa ku ri swakudya u nga si wu xava wu ri xibyariwa xa le kaya.
rows.ve: Vhudzisani nesari ya vhuḓivhi nga vhubvo vhu re mulayoni na u tea ha fhethu ha henefho. Fhedzisani mbudziso ya tshumiso ya zwiḽiwa ni sa athu u u renga sa tshiliṅwa tsha muṱa.

rows.st: Tlaleho e rekota tshebediso ya ho idibatsa ditlhapi (fish-stunning). Ha ho tshebediso e jwalo e kgothaletswang, mme ha ho bolelwe hore ditholwana ke dijo tsa lelapa.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xi rhekhoda ku tirhisiwa ku endla tihlampfi ti hela matimbe (fish-stunning). A ku bumabumeriwi ku tirhisiwa ko tano, naswona a ku vuriwi leswaku mihandzu i swakudya swa le kaya.
rows.ve: Tshiko tshi rekhoda tshumiso ya u ita uri khovhe dzi dzienge (fish-stunning). A hu themendelwa tshumiso yo raloho, nahone a hu buliwi uri mitshelo ndi zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa.

rows.ve: Wanani zwishumiswa zwi re na ḽebuḽu ya Basella alba. Lushaka lwa dzingu ḽa Afrika Tshipembe, ndaedzi ya kg/plant na tshifhinga tsha u kaṋa tshi re na maḓuvha a zwi athu u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: The extension guide reports maturity around 70 days from seed under optimal conditions, followed by hand trimming leaves and young stems. This foreign optimal-condition duration is supplementary; no South African planting date, exact month window or generic tree-age value is inferred.
rows.zu: Umhlahlandlela wabeluleki ubika ukuvuthwa cishe ezinsukwini ezingu-70 kusukela embewini ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, kulandelwe ukusika ngesandla amaqabunga neziqu ezincane. Lesi sikhathi sakwamanye amazwe ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele siyinkomba eyengeziwe; akucatshangwa usuku lokutshala lwaseNingizimu Afrika, isikhathi sezinyanga esiqondile noma inani elivamile lobudala besihlahla.
rows.st: Tataiso ya katoloso ya temo e tlaleha ho hola ho fihlela kotulong matsatsing a ka bang 70 ho tloha peong tlasa maemo a loketseng, ho latelwa ke ho kga makgasi le dikutu tse nyane ka letsoho. Nako ena ya dinaha tse ding tlasa maemo a loketseng ke tshupiso e tlatselletsang; ha ho nahannwe letsatsi la ho jala la Afrika Borwa, nako ya dikgwedi e tobileng kapa boleng bo akaretsang ba dilemo tsa sefate.
rows.ts: Nkongomiso wa vatsundzuxi wu vika ku kula ku fika eku tshoveriweni kwalomu ka masiku ya 70 ku sukela eka mbewu ehansi ka swiyimo leswinene, ku landzela ku tsema matluka ni marhavi lamatsongo hi mavoko. Nkarhi lowu wa matiko mambe ehansi ka swiyimo leswinene i xikombo xo engetela; a ku ehleketeleriwi siku ro byala ra Afrika Dzonga, nkarhi wa tin’hweti lowu kongomeke kumbe nhlayo ya ntolovelo ya vukhale bya murhi.
rows.ve: Nyendedzi ya vhaeletshedzi i vhiga u aluwa u swika kha u kaṋiwa nga maḓuvha a ṱoḓaho u vha 70 u bva kha mbeu fhasi ha nyimele dzavhuḓi, ha tevhela u gera maṱari na tsinde ṱhukhu nga zwanḓa. Tshifhinga itshi tsha mashango a nnḓa fhasi ha nyimele dzavhuḓi ndi ndaedzi ya u engedza; a hu humbulelwi ḓuvha ḽa u ṱavha ḽa Afrika Tshipembe, tshifhinga tsha miṅwedzi tsho tiwaho kana tshivhalo tsho ḓoweleaho tsha vhukale ha muri.

rows.zu: UJanuwari–Julayi usho ukubonakala kwezithelo embhalweni we-SANBI, hhayi isikhathi esiqondile sokuvuna izithelo ezivuthiwe.
rows.st: Pherekgong–Phupu e bolela ho hlaha ha ditholwana tlalehong ya SANBI, eseng nako e hlakileng ya ho kotula ditholwana tse butswitseng.
rows.ts: Sunguti–Mawuwani i ku vonaka ka mihandzu eka xihlovo xa SANBI, ku nga ri nkarhi lowu boxiweke wo tshovela mihandzu leyi vupfeke.
rows.ve: Phando–Fulwana ndi u vhonala ha mitshelo kha tshiko tsha SANBI, hu si tshifhinga tsho bulwaho tsha u kaṋa mitshelo yo vhibvaho.

rows.english: Fruit-development duration has context
rows.zu: Isikhathi sokukhula kwesithelo sinomongo
rows.st: Nako ya ho hola ha tholwana e na le maemo
rows.ts: Nkarhi wa ku kula ka muhandzu wu ni mongo
rows.ve: Tshifhinga tsha u aluwa ha mutshelo tshi na nyimele

rows.english: This is flower-to-fruit development, not years from planting. Its South African January–July fruiting statement is not an observed household picking window.
rows.zu: Lokhu ukukhula kusukela embalini kuya esithelweni, hhayi iminyaka kusukela kutshaliwe. Ukushiwo kokuthela eNingizimu Afrika ngoJanuwari–Julayi akusona isikhathi sokuvuna sasekhaya esibonwe ngempela.
rows.st: Sena ke kgolo ho tloha paleseng ho ya tholwaneng, eseng dilemo ho tloha ha ho jetswe. Polelo ya sona ya ho beha ditholwana Afrika Borwa ka Pherekgong–Phupu ha se nako ya kotulo ya lelapa e bonweng.
rows.ts: Loku i ku kula ku sukela eka bilomu ku ya eka muhandzu, ku nga ri malembe ku sukela loko wu byariwile. Ku vuriwa ka ku veka mihandzu eAfrika Dzonga hi Sunguti–Mawuwani a hi nkarhi wo tshovela wa le kaya lowu voniweke.
rows.ve: Izwi ndi u aluwa u bva kha luvha u ya kha mutshelo, hu si miṅwaha u bva kha u ṱavha. U buliwa ha u aṋwa mitshelo Afrika Tshipembe nga Phando–Fulwana a si tshifhinga tsha muṱa tsha u kaṋa tsho vhonwaho.

rows.english: fruit; traditionally prepared flower buds
rows.zu: izithelo; izimbali ezingakavuleki ezilungiswa ngokwesiko
rows.st: ditholwana; dipalesa tse so kang di buleha tse lokiswang ka setso
rows.ts: mihandzu; mabilomu lama nga si pfulekaka lama lunghiseleriwaka hi ndhavuko
rows.ve: mitshelo; maluvha a sa athu u vuleaho a lugiswaho nga sialala

rows.english: This hardy, drought-resistant tree occurs in drier southern African regions.
rows.zu: Lesi sihlahla esiqinile nesimelana nesomiso sitholakala ezifundeni ezomile zaseningizimu ye-Afrika.
rows.st: Sefate sena se tiileng se mamellang komello se fumaneha dibakeng tse ommeng tsa borwa ba Afrika.
rows.ts: Murhi lowu tiyeke lowu tiyiselaka dyandza wu kumeka eka swifundzha swo oma swa dzonga wa Afrika.
rows.ve: Muri uyu wo khwaṱhaho u konḓelelaho gomelelo u wanala kha madzingu o omaho a tshipembe ha Afrika.

rows.english: SANBI reports that leaf browsing can taint cattle milk. No feed ration is recommended.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ibika ukuthi ukudliwa kwamaqabunga yimfuyo kungashintsha ukunambitheka kobisi lwezinkomo. Akukho sabelo sokudla kwezilwane esinconywayo.
rows.st: SANBI e tlaleha hore ho jewa ha makgasi ke diphoofolo ho ka fetola tatso ya lebese la dikgomo. Ha ho dijo tse lekantsweng tsa diphoofolo tse kgothaletswang.
rows.ts: SANBI yi vika leswaku ku dyiwa ka matluka hi swifuwo ku nga onha nantswo wa masi ya tihomu. A ku bumabumeriwi mpimo wa swakudya swa swifuwo.
rows.ve: SANBI i vhiga uri u ḽiwa ha maṱari nga zwifuwo zwi nga shandula muḓifho wa mafhi a kholomo. A hu themendelwa mukovhe wa zwiḽiwa zwa zwifuwo.

rows.english: Ask for correctly identified, lawfully sourced stock and check current protected-tree collection requirements before harvesting existing wild trees.
rows.zu: Cela izitshalo ezikhonjwe kahle nezitholwe ngokusemthethweni, uhlole nezidingo zamanje zokuqoqwa kwezihlahla ezivikelwe ngaphambi kokuvuna ezihlahleni zasendle ezikhona.
rows.st: Kopa dimela tse hlwauweng ka nepo, tse fumanweng ka molao, mme o hlahlobe ditlhoko tsa hona jwale tsa ho bokella difate tse sireleditsweng pele o kotula difateng tse teng tse hlaha.
rows.ts: Kombela swimilana leswi tivekaka kahle leswi kumiweke hi nawu u tlhela u kambela swilaveko swa sweswi swo hlengeleta mirhi leyi sirhelelekeke u nga si tshovela eka mirhi ya nhova leyi nga kona.
rows.ve: Humbelani zwimela zwo ṱalulwaho zwavhuḓi zwo wanalaho nga mulayo ni ṱole ṱhoḓea dza zwino dza u kuvhanganya miri yo tsireledzwaho ni sa athu u kaṋa kha miri ya ḓaka i re hone.

rows.english: SANBI also records flower-bud pickle use. Root porridge/coffee references are not instructions to harvest roots or a complete preparation guide.
rows.zu: I-SANBI iphinde irekhode ukusetshenziswa kwezimbali ezingakavuleki njenge-pickle. Izinkomba zephalishi/zekhofi lezimpande aziyona imiyalelo yokuvuna izimpande noma umhlahlandlela ophelele wokulungisa.
rows.st: SANBI e boetse e rekota tshebediso ya dipalesa tse so kang di buleha e le pickle. Ditshupiso tsa motoho/kofi ya metso ha se ditaelo tsa ho kotula metso kapa tataiso e felletseng ya ho lokisa.
rows.ts: SANBI yi tlhela yi rhekhoda ku tirhisiwa ka mabilomu lama nga si pfulekaka lama endliweke pickle. Swikombo swa vuswa/kofi ya timitsu a hi swileriso swo tshovela timitsu kumbe nkongomiso lowu heleleke wa ku lunghiselela.
rows.ve: SANBI i dovha ya rekhoda tshumiso ya maluvha a sa athu u vuleaho o itwaho pickle. Ndaedzi dza vhuswa/gofhi ya midzi a si ndaela dza u kaṋa midzi kana nyendedzi yo fhelelaho ya u lugisela.

rows.english: dry grain or green immature seed; fodder is a separate product
rows.zu: izinhlamvu ezomile noma imbewu eluhlaza engakavuthwa; ukudla kwemfuyo kungumkhiqizo ohlukile
rows.st: dijo-thollo tse ommeng kapa peo e tala e so butswe; furu ke sehlahiswa se arohaneng
rows.ts: ndzoho leyi omeke kumbe mbewu ya rihlaza leyi nga si vupfaka; furu i xikumiwa xo hambana
rows.ve: thoro dzo omaho kana mbeu dala i sa athu u vhibvaho; furu ndi tshibveledzwa tsho fhambanaho

rows.english: Record green immature seed and dry grain separately; fodder biomass cannot be counted as household food kg.
rows.zu: Rekhoda imbewu eluhlaza engakavuthwa nezinhlamvu ezomile ngokwehlukana; isisindo sezitshalo sokudla kwemfuyo asibalwa kuma-kg okudla kwasekhaya.
rows.st: Rekota peo e tala e so butswe le dijo-thollo tse ommeng ka thoko; boima ba dimela ba furu bo ke ke ba balwa e le kg tsa dijo tsa lelapa.
rows.ts: Rhekhoda mbewu ya rihlaza leyi nga si vupfaka ni ndzoho leyi omeke swi hambanile; ntiko wa swimilana swa furu a wu hlayiwi ku ri kg ta swakudya swa le kaya.
rows.ve: Rekhodani mbeu dala i sa athu u vhibvaho na thoro dzo omaho nga thungo; tshileme tsha zwimela zwa furu a tshi vhalelwi kha kg dza zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa.

rows.english: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.
rows.zu: Fanisa uhlobo lwesikhathi esikhethiwe nosuku lokutshala nesithwathwa, imvula nokutholakala kwamanzi endaweni; ucwaningo lugcina izimo zalo.
rows.st: Bapisa mofuta wa bolelele ba nako o kgethilweng le letsatsi la ho jala le serame sa sebaka, pula le boteng ba metsi; diteko di boloka maemo a tsona.
rows.ts: Fananisa muxaka wa nkarhi lowu hlawuriweke ni siku ro byala ni rharhama ra ndhawu, mpfula ni ku kumeka ka mati; mindzingo yi hlayisa swiyimo swa yona.
rows.ve: Yelanyisani lushaka lwa vhulapfu ha tshifhinga lwo nangwaho na ḓuvha ḽa u ṱavha na murotholo wa henefho, mvula na u wanala ha maḓi; milingo i vhulunga nyimele dzayo.

rows.english: Discuss the named SA trial cultivars with a local seed supplier or extension adviser. Current purchase availability and suitability for this site are unverified; do not substitute a cultivar silently.
rows.zu: Xoxa ngezinhlobo eziqanjwe ocwaningweni lwaseNingizimu Afrika nomhlinzeki wembewu wendawo noma umeluleki wezolimo. Ukutholakala kwazo manje nokufaneleka kwazo kule ndawo akuqinisekisiwe; ungafaki olunye uhlobo buthule esikhundleni salo.
rows.st: Buisana ka mefuta e bitswang ka mabitso ditekong tsa Afrika Borwa le mofani wa peo kapa moeletsi wa temo wa sebaka. Boteng ba ho reka hona jwale le ho lokela ha sebaka sena ha di a netefatswa; o se ke wa kenya mofuta o mong sebakeng sa wona ka sephiri.
rows.ts: Burisana hi tinxaka leti nga ni mavito ta mindzingo ya Afrika Dzonga ni muphakeri wa mbewu kumbe mutsundzuxi wa vurimi wa ndhawu. Ku kumeka ka tona ku xaviwa sweswi ni ku faneleka ka tona eka ndhawu leyi a swi tiyisisiwanga; u nga sivi muxaka hi wun’wana u nga tivisanga.
rows.ve: Haseledzani tshaka dzi re na madzina dza milingo ya Afrika Tshipembe na muṋetshedzi wa mbeu kana mueletshedzi wa vhulimi wa henefho. U wanala ha u renga ha zwino na u tea ha fhethu hafha a zwo ngo khwaṱhisedzwa; ni songo tshintsha lushaka nga luṅwe ni sa zwi buli.

rows.zu: Ukuvuthwa kwezinhlobo nocwaningo lwezinhlamvu lwaseNingizimu Afrika
rows.st: Ho butswa ha mefuta le teko ya dijo-thollo ya Afrika Borwa
rows.ts: Ku vupfa ka tinxaka ni ndzingo wa ndzoho wa Afrika Dzonga
rows.ve: U vhibva ha tshaka na mulingo wa thoro wa Afrika Tshipembe

rows.english: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; rainfed mid-December sowing, sandy loam, no fertiliser. Paired days after planting / grain kg/ha: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Grain differences within each trial were not significant. Visually checked Tables 1–2 (PDF pp43–44). These are dry-grain observations, not green-seed picking dates or nationwide yield defaults.
rows.zu: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; ukutshala maphakathi noDisemba kuncike emvuleni, emhlabathini we-sandy loam, kungekho manyolo. Izinsuku ngemva kokutshala / izinhlamvu kg/ha zibhangqwe kanje: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Umehluko wezinhlamvu ocwaningweni ngalunye awubalulekile ngokwezibalo. Amathebula 1–2 ahlolwe ngokuwabuka (PDF pp43–44). Lokhu okubonwe ngezinhlamvu ezomile, akuzona izinsuku zokuvuna imbewu eluhlaza noma izivuno ezimisiwe zezwe lonke.
rows.st: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; ho jala bohareng ba Tshitwe ho itshetlehileng ka pula, mobung wa sandy loam, ho se na manyolo. Matsatsi ka mora ho jala / dijo-thollo kg/ha di tsamaisana tjena: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Diphapang tsa dijo-thollo tekong ka nngwe ha di bohlokwa ka dipalopalo. Ho hlahlobilwe Dithebole 1–2 ka ho di sheba (PDF pp43–44). Tsena ke tse bonweng ka dijo-thollo tse ommeng, eseng matsatsi a ho kotula peo e tala kapa chai e behilweng bakeng sa naha yohle.
rows.ts: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; ku byala exikarhini ka N'wendzamhala ku titshege hi mpfula, eka misava ya sandy loam, ku nga ri na manyoro. Masiku endzhaku ko byala / ndzoho kg/ha swi fambisana hi ndlela leyi: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Ku hambana ka ndzoho endzeni ka ndzingo wun’wana ni wun’wana a ku nga ri na nkoka hi tinhlayo ta ndzavisiso. Matafula ya 1–2 ma kamberiwile hi ku ma languta (PDF pp43–44). Leyi i mivono ya ndzoho leyi omeke, ku nga ri masiku yo tshovela mbewu ya rihlaza kumbe mintshovelo leyi vekiweke ya tiko hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; u ṱavha vhukati ha Nyendavhusiku ho ḓitikaho nga mvula, kha mavu a sandy loam, hu si na manyoro. Maḓuvha nga murahu ha u ṱavha / thoro kg/ha zwi yelana nga heyi nḓila: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Phambano dza thoro kha mulingo muṅwe na muṅwe a dzi dza ndeme nga mbalo dza ṱhoḓisiso. Thebuḽu 1–2 dzo ṱolwa nga u dzi sedza (PDF pp43–44). Izwi ndi zwe zwa vhonwa nga thoro dzo omaho, hu si maḓuvha a u kaṋa mbeu dala kana khaṋo dzo tiwaho dza shango ḽoṱhe.
